data.name: Removr
data.description: Removr is a Norwegian direct air capture company jointly owned by Vanir Green Industries and GreenCap Solutions, developing zeolite-based solid-sorbent DAC technology. The company is piloting its technology with SINTEF in Oslo and at Technology Centre Mongstad, and is part of the RMI-led Ankeron Carbon Management Hub feasibility consortium in the US Pacific Northwest. Its stated ambition is to build the world's first 1-million-ton solid sorbent DAC plant.
